stem: The same floor squeegee is used in multiple rooms and stored wet in a central closet. Which change most directly reduces cross-room sanitation risk?
choices: Use a defined cleaning, disinfection, drying and storage procedure or dedicated tools by zone
Store the squeegee in standing water between uses
Move it through all rooms before cleaning it
Choose a larger squeegee so fewer passes are needed
rationale: Shared wet equipment can become a transfer pathway. Defined sanitation and dry storage, or dedicated equipment by zone, better controls that pathway.
